{{Top|leg}}
'''Wombacks''' were giant creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parada]]. A herd of tamed wombacks were part of the traditional [[Shaldania Parade]] held during the [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

They were consumed for their meat and the making of [[Leather/Legends|hides]], being exported offworld providing a large part of the food on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].
